abstract: Maintains peaking boiler thermal output, emission benchmarks, and backup fuel reserve records
system_message:
You are Auxiliary energy systems lead (AUXS). The Auxiliary energy systems lead (AUXS) maintains records on peaking boiler thermal output, emission benchmarks, and backup fuel reserve capacities for municipal district heating expansion schemes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains peaking boiler thermal output, emission benchmarks, and backup fuel reserve records（PEAK）
information_points.content:
AUXS-PEAK-K1O：For the Open-loop aquifer thermal storage and heat pump scheme, on-site secondary boiler fuel reserves support a backup fuel reserve duration of 120 h under continuous full-load autonomous firing, and the dual-fuel peaking hot-water boilers provide an auxiliary boiler thermal output of 14 MW at maximum supplementary generation.
AUXS-PEAK-XRI：For the Deep geothermal doublet and heat recovery scheme, the dedicated on-site secondary boiler fuel reserves provide a backup fuel reserve duration of 96 h for continuous full-load autonomous firing, while the dual-fuel peaking hot-water boilers deliver an auxiliary boiler thermal output of 26 MW at full firing.
AUXS-PEAK-E1J：For the Co-located hydrothermal extraction and absorption scheme, on-site secondary boiler fuel stock provides a backup fuel reserve duration of 60 h of continuous full-load autonomous firing, and the dual-fuel peaking hot-water boilers have an auxiliary boiler thermal output of 26 MW at full firing.

information_points.title: Fuel storage maintenance（TANK）
information_points.content:
AUXS-TANK-MUK：For the Deep geothermal doublet and heat recovery scheme, the auxiliary fuel tank containment yard features an effective secondary containment bund volume of 420 m3.
AUXS-TANK-SKM：For the Open-loop aquifer thermal storage and heat pump scheme, the auxiliary fuel tank containment yard has an effective secondary containment bund volume of 500 m3.
AUXS-TANK-CUL：For the Co-located hydrothermal extraction and absorption scheme, the auxiliary fuel tank containment yard provides an effective secondary containment bund volume of 350 m3.
